verdict.rationale: Docs confirm users can choose models from OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Bedrock, or self-hosted models, configure custom model endpoints in the dashboard, and that orgs explicitly connect/configure/grant specific models to projects rather than relying on automatic selection. missing for 10: no explicit UI walkthrough showing a default 'automatic' mode being overridden, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of manual model switching in practice.
